description: This file implements functions for managing category boards within a project, including retrieval, creation, updating, reordering, and visibility toggling of category boards, with websocket notifications for changes.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods for managing category boards.

methods.name: GetUserCategoryBoards
methods.description: Retrieves user category boards, creating default categories if necessary.

methods.name: createDefaultCategoriesIfRequired
methods.description: Checks for existence of default category and creates it if missing.

methods.name: createBoardsCategory
methods.description: Creates a default 'Boards' category and moves unassigned boards into it.

methods.name: AddUpdateUserCategoryBoard
methods.description: Adds or updates boards in a user's category and broadcasts change.

methods.name: ReorderCategoryBoards
methods.description: Reorders boards within a category after validation.

methods.name: verifyNewCategoryBoardsMatchExisting
methods.description: Validates that the new order includes all existing boards.

methods.name: SetBoardVisibility
methods.description: Sets visibility of a board within a category and broadcasts change.
